left.label: Context panel
media.title: Media
media.dragHint: Drag to the timeline · double-click to preview
media.noneHint: Import from your PotionUI library or gallery, from this computer, or drop files here.
media.useAsFrame: Use as frame at the playhead
media.deleteTip: Remove from the project; the file stays in your library
story.title: Storyboard
story.placeholder: Tell the film in a few sentences: each sentence becomes a shot.
story.proposeTip: Sentence split; ask the assistant for a real breakdown
story.sequenceHint: Final film makes each shot final from its Final take; “Sequence” with Final in the Production bar renders everything again.
story.allDone: Every shot is final or comes from a source.
story.noShots: No shots yet: write the synopsis and propose a breakdown, or add a shot in the Storyboard.
story.continuityOk: Color and identity matches are consistent.
story.continuityNone: No match to check yet: the shots have no image.
queue.title: Generation queue
queue.slotsTip: Takes handed to the engine, out of how many of your takes may run at once.
queue.elsewhere.one: {count} more take of yours is in the queue for another project: all your projects share one queue.
queue.elsewhere.other: {count} more takes of yours are in the queue for other projects: all your projects share one queue.
queue.emptyHint: The takes waiting for the engine or running on it show here, in the order they run.
queue.prioritize: Move take {variant} to the head of the queue
queue.prioritizeTip: Move to the head of the queue
queue.prioritizeNo: Already first, or already handed to the engine
dock.bible.label: Visual tag
dock.bible.labelHint.characters: the red-haired woman in the navy raincoat
dock.bible.noLabel: Without a visual tag, the card enters no prompt. Write it the same way in the instructions of the shots.
dock.bible.textHint.characters: One fixed paragraph: face, hair, build, costume.
dock.bible.textHint.places: One fixed paragraph: place, light, materials.
dock.bible.propsHint: a brass lantern, a red scarf
dock.bible.voiceHint: a low, husky voice, slow pace
dock.bible.voiceRefHint: In Ref2VA, this sound is defined as the character's voice when the shot sends it. It is never mixed onto a take.
dock.bible.voiceRefEmpty: Add a sound to the references (Sound family) to give the character a voice sample.
dock.bible.referencesHint.characters: Optional. With MiniMax H3 in Ref2VA, a linked Identity reference sent with a shot is defined with the words of this card.
dock.bible.referencesHint.places: Optional. With MiniMax H3 in Ref2VA, a linked Sets reference sent with a shot is defined with the words of this card.
dock.bible.noReferences.characters: The project has no Identity reference.
dock.bible.noReferences.places: The project has no Sets reference.
dock.bible.removed: Card deleted, and taken out of the shots that cast it.
dock.bible.convert: The Characters and identity field is free text added to the prompt of every shot. You can keep it, or turn it into a character card cast in every shot.
dock.bible.converted.one: Card created and cast in {count} shot: check its visual tag.
dock.bible.converted.other: Card created and cast in {count} shots: check its visual tag.
director.check.title: To check
director.check.cited: {shot}: the card {name} is named but not cast
director.check.unnamed: {shot}: the card {name} is cast but not named in the instruction
director.review.noShotsHint: Split the synopsis into shots in the Storyboard, then generate them with the Production bar.
director.review.noTakes: No take: {key} generates the chosen shot.
director.review.seamTip: Choose this seam: end and start in the panel
director.review.finals.one: {count} shot with a final out of {total}
director.review.finals.other: {count} shots with a final out of {total}
director.direction.subtitle: {chars} / {max} chars · added to the prompt of every shot
director.direction.castText: Characters and places are cards of the Bible, cast shot by shot. This field stays a free text added to the prompt of every shot.
director.bible.languageTip: The language the lines are spoken in, unless a character sets its own
director.bible.chipTip: See the takes of {shot} · {name} in the Review
director.bible.emptyHint: One card per character or place: its text goes word for word into the shots that cast it, its images to the engines that take them.
director.aside.hint: The prompt this shot would send to the engine of the project with the current direction. It follows what you type.
director.aside.follows: Follows the chosen shot. Choosing one here pins it.
director.aside.followsIssue: Follows the chosen contradiction. Choosing another shot here pins it.
director.aside.first: No shot chosen: the first shot with an instruction. Choosing one here pins it.
director.aside.pinned: Pinned here: it no longer follows the chosen shot.
director.aside.issue: The two highlighted sentences contradict each other: the engine will receive both.
director.aside.none: Create shots in the Storyboard to see the composed prompt.
director.aside.noCard: Choose a card of the Bible to edit it here.
director.pick.changed: The instruction of {shot} has changed: this take no longer follows it.
director.pick.missing: In green, what this take lacks.
director.pick.relaunch: {key} generates {shot} again with the current instruction.
director.pick.sentHint: The text the engine received for this take, as recorded at generation.
director.pick.noSent: This take did not keep the text sent to the engine.
director.pick.toOtherTip: Then the Compare icon of another card
director.pick.seamsHint: Preview without measure: the gap is measured once the take is placed.
director.pick.lookHint: SigLIP compares the overall look of the take (costume, light, face) with the pictures of each card cast in the shot; it is not a face recognition.
director.pick.chained: {next} starts from the end of {shot}: placing this take would change its first image.
director.pick.chainedPlaced: {next} starts from the end of this take.
director.pick.fix.retryHint: Same settings, same seed: useful if another render held the server.
director.pick.fix.engineHint: A lighter resolution or profile for the project.
director.pick.fix.shorterHint: A shorter shot asks the engine for fewer frames.
director.pick.fix.instructionHint: The server refused this text: rephrase it, then retry.
director.pick.fix.previousHint: This take started from the end of {shot}: run its take again first.
director.pick.takesHint: They arrive in the row of {shot}; a finished take is chosen with a click.
director.pick.storyboardTip: The shot is set in the Storyboard
director.pick.compareSeamTip: The two placed takes side by side, in the Review monitor
director.pick.emptyTitle: Choose a take or a shot
director.pick.emptyText: Its sent prompt, its seams and what changed since appear here.
director.refs.pickShotHint: Choose the shot that gets it: nothing changes until then.
director.refs.notCastBy: Shots that do not cast its card
director.refs.cardText.one: The text of the card {name} goes into its shot, whatever the engine.
director.refs.cardText.other: The text of the card {name} goes into its {count} shots, whatever the engine.
director.refs.cardNone: The card {name} is cast in no shot: its text is not sent.
director.refs.blind.one: {engines} does not get this reference itself.
director.refs.blind.other: {engines} do not get this reference itself.
director.refs.blindStart.one: {engines} gets no reference picture: it can serve to make the start image of a shot.
director.refs.blindStart.other: {engines} get no reference picture: it can serve to make the start image of a shot.
director.refs.ownWords.one: {shots} sends its own words instead of the composed text.
director.refs.ownWords.other: {shots} send their own words instead of the composed text.
director.refs.lostWords.one: {shots}: its own words were written for another engine; the composed text is sent.
director.refs.lostWords.other: {shots}: their own words were written for another engine; the composed text is sent.
director.refs.goingTip: See the takes of {shot} in the Review
director.refs.startImageFor: Start image from this reference, for…
director.refs.startImageTip: Opens {shot} on its start images: this reference goes there with the other pictures of the shot.
director.refs.noShots: Create shots in the Storyboard to see what each engine gets.
director.refs.shotUnknown: The engine of this shot is not available: what it gets is unknown.
director.refs.shotBlocked: {engine} cannot run the {profile} profile: this shot is not sent.
director.refs.shotMedia: {engine} gets the references themselves: up to {image} pictures, {video} videos and {audio} sounds.
director.refs.shotNoMedia: {engine} does not get the pictures: only the text of the cast cards is sent.
director.refs.rule: Only the Ref2VA profile sends the references themselves. The other engines only get the text of the cast cards, and some mix the sounds onto the take.
director.refs.emptyText: You will see where it goes and what the engine of each shot gets of it.
director.bible.noReferences: No linked picture or voice: only its text is sent.
